item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - The Outpost (Original Television Soundtrack)
item.description:
Does anybody have a download link for the soundtrack for the first season of The Outpost?



It used to be on streaming platforms, but for some reason it’s been removed and now we only have the soundtrack for seasons 2 and 3.
